model

Class Map

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.Map

  • public class Map
extends java.lang.Object
    The Map class represents a 2D grid structure used to model a zoo map. It contains constants for different types of cells (e.g., available spaces, veterinary clinics, and non-enabled spaces) and provides methods to initialize and manage the map. The map is represented as a 10x10 grid, where each cell is a string indicating its type.
